item.title: Missing Agent tab
item.body:
Hi, yesterday I tried CodeGeeX and was amazed by how good it is,
Today I wanted to do so again but now for some reason the "Agent" tab is gone, I can only ask :(

comments.body: Maybe you didn't open any workspace(or folder)? Try open one and wait some seconds to load.
I just tried again, file, folder, workspace open, restarted vscode but it never appears :(
Check vscode's Output -> Window and Extension Host, maybe there are some errors?

I don't see any errors but if you wanna check it
Extension Host doesn't have any errors either.
